name: Batch
author: Shane Poppleton
description: Run a script of your own over every file in a folder, one at a time, with progress in the bar.

barWidget.description: Pick an input folder, an output folder and a script, then run the script over every file in the folder.

schema.label: Only these extensions
schema.description: Space-separated, for example "mp4 mov mkv" or "cr3 nef". Leave empty to process every file in the folder.

schema.label: Scripts folder
schema.description: Where the script dropdown looks. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/batch/scripts.

schema.label: Per-file timeout (minutes)
schema.description: A single file that takes longer than this is abandoned and counted as failed, and the batch moves on.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar checks for a batch it did not start itself. A running batch is polled every second regardless.
